## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue (for example, `Fixes #123`).

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots.

## Compatibility

List affected packages, breaking changes and migration steps, or write “None”.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits, for example `fix(ns_utils): handle empty input`.
- [ ] Relevant analysis and tests pass; behavior changes have appropriate tests.
- [ ] Documentation/examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] Package versions and changelogs are left to Melos.
- [ ] New public packages include a README, LICENSE, tests and release setup from `docs/RELEASING.md`.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or generated build output are included.
